method: Letter series with fixed steps per position
steps: First letters H,K,N,Q,T -> +3 -> W
Second P,L,H,D,Z -> -4 -> V
Third L,Q,V,A,F -> +5 -> K
Answer WVK
P x S: P is brother of S
S ÷ M: S is daughter of M
M − T: M is wife of T, so S and P are children of T
T + R: T is son of R
P is son of T who is son of R: P is R's son's son
Some postcards are books and all books are novels, so some postcards are novels: I follows
Cards may or may not be books: II not certain
Cards need not be novels: III not certain
check_code:
from itertools import product
# regions over 4 sets C,P,B,N; a model = set of nonempty region types
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
import itertools
ok=[]
def sat(m):
    C=lambda r:r[0];P=lambda r:r[1];B=lambda r:r[2];N=lambda r:r[3]
    if any(r[0] and not r[1] for r in m): return False
    if not any(r[1] and r[2] for r in m): return False
    if any(r[2] and not r[3] for r in m): return False
    if not any(r[0] for r in m): return False
    return True
res={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
for mask in range(1,1<<16):
    m=[regs[i] for i in range(16) if mask>>i&1]
    if not sat(m): continue
    res['I']&=any(r[1] and r[3] for r in m)
    res['II']&=not any(r[0] and r[2] for r in m)
    res['III']&=all(r[3] for r in m if r[0])
follow={k for k,v in res.items() if v}
opts={'A':{'II','III'},'B':{'I','II'},'C':{'I'},'D':{'III'}}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follow]==['C']

method: Dice: common face and cyclic order
steps: O is the right face in both views, so M,N,K,J are the four faces around O and L is opposite O
View 1: top M, front N; view 2: top K, front J
The ring around O in order is M,N,K,J, so opposite pairs are M-K and N-J
Opposite J is N
check_code:
import itertools
ring_views=[('M','N'),('K','J')]  # (top,front) with O on right; front follows top in ring order
faces=['J','K','M','N']
sols=set()
for p in itertools.permutations(faces):
    if p[0]!='M': continue
    ok=all(any(p[i]==a and p[(i+1)%4]==b for i in range(4)) for a,b in ring_views)
    if ok: sols.add(p[(p.index('J')+2)%4])
assert len(sols)==1
ans=sols.pop()
opts={'A':'N','B':'M','C':'O','D':'L'}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==ans]==['A']
